extracted.intended_audience: students, professional writers, journalists, and editors
extracted.subtask_description: Authoritative style and usage rules for news writing and editing as set out by The Associated Press; intended to help writers and editors produce clear, professional journalism consistent with AP practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Style guidelines for news writing, editing, and common usage
rubrics_metrics.description: Master the style guidelines of news writing, editing, and common usage with this indispensable guide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The AP Stylebook will help you master the AP's rules on grammar, spelling, punctuation, capitalization, abbreviation, word and numeral usage, and when to use "more than" instead of "over."

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity and professionalism
rubrics_metrics.description: Write and edit with the clarity and professionalism for which AP writers and editors are famous.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: With the AP Stylebook in hand, you can learn how to write and edit with the clarity and professionalism for which their writers and editors are famous.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grammar
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and guidance governing grammar in news writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The AP's rules on grammar (as part of the comprehensive style guidance provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Spelling
rubrics_metrics.description: Preferred spellings and variants for news copy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The AP's rules on spelling (included among the topics the Stylebook covers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Punctuation
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for punctuation usage in AP-style news copy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The AP's rules on punctuation (included among the topics the Stylebook covers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for when and how to capitalize words in news writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The AP's rules on capitalization (included among the topics the Stylebook covers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Abbreviation
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on forming and using abbreviations and acronyms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The AP's rules on abbreviation (included among the topics the Stylebook covers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Word usage
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on choice of words and usages deemed appropriate by AP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The AP's rules on word usage (included among the topics the Stylebook covers), including specific usage decisions such as when to use "more than" instead of "over."

rubrics_metrics.name: Numeral usage
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on when to spell out numbers vs. use numerals and related numeric conventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The AP's rules on numeral usage (included among the topics the Stylebook covers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific usage examples and edge-case guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Concrete prescriptions for particular word/phrase choices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example provided on the page: guidance on "when to use 'more than' instead of 'over.'" The Stylebook includes many such specific usage decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with current events, common usage, and AP procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Style guidance is kept current and reflects evolving language, news context, and AP internal procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fully revised and updated to keep pace with world events, common usage, and AP procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authoritative consistency (AP as a standard)
rubrics_metrics.description: AP style serves as the authoritative, standardized set of conventions for newsrooms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The style of The Associated Press is the gold standard for news writing.
